Ani R.: Quick evening handover — I'm off at 19:00 PT. Leaving a short list of things to watch/act on overnight:
- Deploy: canary v3.2.1 went out at 18:50 PT (canary traffic 5%).
- Observed: small bump in embedding requests around 18:40 (likely nightly batch).
- Known risk: canary shows ~50ms p50 regression on chat model vs stable (monitor p50/p95).
- Cache: prefix-KV cache is being warmed; hit rate should be >=60%.
- Redis: eviction spike earlier, resolved by failover, but watch evictions metric.
- Action items below; runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy success — v3.2.1 canary started at 2026-03-16T18:50:12Z. Canary traffic: 5%.

Kevin L.: thanks Ani. quick Q: any special checks for the canary beyond p50/p95? logs or error patterns to watch for?

Ani R.: Good Q — focus on:
- 5xx rate for `/v1/generate` and `/v1/embeddings` (threshold: >1% sustained for 10m)
- prefix cache hit rate (threshold: <60% for 15m)
- abnormal queue depth in inference pods (>200 requests queued)
- token generation timeouts (see logs)

If you need to pull logs quickly:
```bash
# tail inference logs, filter errors
redwoodctl logs -f deployment/inference --since=10m | grep -i "error\|timeout\|traceback"

# check canary pod queue lengths
redwoodctl exec -it deployment/inference-canary -- /bin/bash -c "cat /proc/self/queue_len"
```

If >1% 5xx for 10m -> rollback canary: `redwoodctl rollback canary v3.2.0` and @pagerduty escalate.

Tara S.: FYI I left a note on the metrics dash — golden-eval chat p50 jumped from ~120ms to ~170ms on canary. p95 unchanged. Suspect small kernel scheduling variance on new kernels; worth watching but not auto-rollback yet. Link: https://dash.redwood/golden-evals/2026-03-16

Ani R.: Action items for tonight: 
1) If 5xx >1% for 10m -> rollback and ping #incidents + @Tara S.
2) If prefix cache hit rate <60% for 15m -> try `cache-warmup` job (see runbook) and notify me.
3) If Redis evictions >150k/min -> restart replica: `infractl service restart redis-replica-2` and notify ops.
4) I'll follow up tomorrow morning with canary analysis and next steps.

devrel-bot: :pencil2: Runbook updated by Ani R. — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference (v2.4)

Kevin L.: Ack — I'm on pager 19:00–23:00 PT, will watch latency + errors. I'll post if I start seeing steady regressions.

Tara S.: Thanks — I'm reachable if you need escalation after 21:30 PT. If you see memory pressure on Redis, prefer restart over failover (restart is faster for this cluster).

Ani R.: Great, thanks all. One last note: if you see a sudden drop in embedding throughput, check the batcher logs for the embed service — there was a throttling rule added last week. Command:
`redwoodctl logs service/embed-batcher --since=30m | grep throttle`

Kevin L.: Got it, will keep an eye. enjoy the evening :)

Tara S.: Good handover — pinned.

Ani R.: Thanks — leaving the thread here. @oncall-bot please add this to daily handovers archive.
